simple.summary: מִשְׁבָּר (mishbâr) means a breaker (of the sea) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 5.

definitions.full: H4867. mishbar [ מִשְׁבָּר ] noun [masculine] breaker , of sea; — plural construct מִשְׁבְּרֵייָֿם Psa 93:4 (|| רַבִּים מַיִם קֹלוֺת ; in compare of ׳י s majesty); figurative of calamities, מִשְׁבְּרֵימָֿוֶת 2Sam 22:5 ( חֶבְלֵימָֿוֶת in || Psa 18:5 ); as sent by מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ ׳י, 88:8 , ׳מ וְגַלֶּיךָ 42:8 ; Jonah 2:4 . — Job 41:17 see שֶׁבֶר . above
